excerpt: The Search for Hidden Particles (SHiP/NA67) is a general-purpose, high-intensity beam dump experiment approved in 2024 for the future exploitation of the ECN3 experimental hall at the CERN Super-Proton-Synchrotron in conjunction with the new Beam Dump Facility (BDF). It will collect 6x10^20 protons on target over ~15 years of operation.
title: The SHiP/NA67 experiment at the ECN3 high-intensity beam facility at the CERN SPS
